# superset_role (Resource)

Manages a role and its permission view menus (PVM) within Apache Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_role" "analyst" {
  name = "Data_Analyst"
  permissions = [
    data.superset_permission.can_read_dashboard.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role (e.g., 'Finance_Analyst', 'Data_Engineer').

### Optional

- `permissions` (List of Number) List of permission view menu (PVM) IDs assigned to this role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the role as a string.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import role by numeric ID
terraform import superset_role.analyst 12
```
